settings.flake_dir.label: Flake checkout
settings.flake_dir.description: Git checkout of the flake this host is built from. Empty turns the config check off. Needs system.configurationRevision set in the NixOS config (see the README).
settings.remote_ref.label: Remote branch
settings.remote_ref.description: Branch the running revision is compared with, such as origin/main. Its remote is fetched on the interval below.
settings.watch_paths.label: Count commits touching
settings.watch_paths.description: Only count commits that change these paths (git pathspecs, such as nix/hosts/myhost or flake.lock). Empty counts every commit.
settings.fetch_minutes.label: Fetch every (minutes)
settings.fetch_minutes.description: How often to git fetch the remote. 0 never fetches and compares with what is already fetched.
settings.store_check_hours.label: Recount the store every (hours)
settings.store_check_hours.description: Summing the store takes several seconds, so it runs at low priority on this interval, after a switch or clean, and on request. 0 counts only on request or after generations change.
settings.low_disk_gib.label: Low disk warning (GiB free)
settings.low_disk_gib.description: The icon turns red when the disk holding /nix/store has less free space than this.
settings.update_command.label: Update command
settings.update_command.description: Shown as an Update button in the panel and run in a terminal, such as nh os switch ~/flake. Empty hides the button.
settings.clean_command.label: Clean command
settings.clean_command.description: Run in a terminal by the panel's Clean button. Empty hides the button.
settings.optimise_command.label: Optimise command
settings.optimise_command.description: Run in a terminal by the panel's Optimise button, such as nix store optimise. Empty hides the button.
settings.keep_terminal_open.label: Keep terminal open
settings.keep_terminal_open.description: Wait for Enter after a command finishes, so its output can be read.
settings.text_format.label: Bar text
settings.text_format.description: Placeholders: {generation}, {generations}, {closure}, {store}, {store_paths}, {disk_free}, {behind}. Empty shows only the icon.
settings.show_markers.label: Show markers
settings.show_markers.description: Prefix the text with ↻ when a reboot is needed and ↓N when the system is N commits behind.
